# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat, stolid youth with a round, expressionless face.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

He is extremely quiet and suffers from a painful lack of conversational gifts, rarely thinking of a reply until it is too late. Despite his quiet nature, he holds a strong, shy admiration for Anne Shirley and gets puffed up with pride in her company, though he is easily terrified by social settings with unfamiliar people.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_

## Traits

- Stolid  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Lacks conversational skills  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Shy around others  <sub>[v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)</sub>

## Abilities

- Driving a horse and buggy  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## History

Billy lived in Avonlea as part of the Andrews family. He drove his sister Jane, Anne Shirley, and Diana Barry to the White Sands Hotel for a charity concert in his double-seated buggy. During the drive, he insisted that Anne sit beside him on the front seat, thoroughly admiring her despite his inability to keep up a conversation. After the concert, he fled in fear of being invited to the formal performers' supper, but waited outside with the team to drive the girls safely home.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_
